summary: Kairos Pharma filed an 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) furnishing a press release on October 6, 2026, reporting positive, statistically significant interim Phase 2 efficacy data for ENV-105 (carotuximab) plus apalutamide in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. Median progression-free survival was 17.7 months for the combination versus 2 months for apalutamide alone (P=0.0008). The protocol was amended to enroll earlier-line patients randomized to enzalutamide with or without ENV-105, targeting Phase 2 completion in or before the fourth quarter. No transaction, consideration, advisor, or board recommendation is involved; this is routine clinical data disclosure, not a special situation.
